1) the number of action units perceived in a videotaped sequence was a function of the importance of the behavior, 2) the more important a behavior is perceived to be the more action units were perceived in the behavior sequence, and 3) the number of perceived action units in a behavior sequence increased as the importance of the action units increased.
subjects were more likely to perceive a larger number of behavior units when they had a higher subjective importance of the units.
